THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS

, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL JUDGMENT Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
2.

This appeal is preferred by the claimant seeking enhancement of compensation against the judgment and award dated 10.04.2023 in MVC No.349/2020, on the file of learned Senior Civil Judge and MACT-II at Aland, Kalaburagi district (hereinafter referred to as 'Tribunal').
3.

Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties and taking into account the finding recorded by the Tribunal, it is not in dispute as to occurrence of the accident on 04.10.2019, in which the claimant had sustained grievous injuries.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:990 HC-KAR 4.

After considering the injuries sustained by the claimant as per the wound certificate at Ex.P5 and the disability certificate at Ex.P10, I am of the view that, the disability to the extent of 20% has to be taken into consideration by looking into the nature of the injuries instead of 14% as assessed by the Tribunal.

In that view of the matter, after applying the proper multiplier of 17, the claimant is entitled for Rs.5,40,600/- towards loss of future income (Rs.13,250x12x17x20%).
5.

By considering the nature of injuries sustained by the claimant, the award of compensation made by the Tribunal is required to be reassessed as follows:
Kumar vs Pintu And Anr on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132110075/
2

Heads Amount Pain and suffering Rs.40,000/-
Loss of earnings during laid up Rs.39,750/- period (Rs.13,250x3) Loss of amenities Rs.40,000/-
Loss of future of earnings Rs.5,40,600/- Towards food and nourishment Rs.10,000/- Medical expenses Rs.29,581/-
Total Rs.6,99,931/-
Less: awarded by Tribunal Rs.4,31,709/-
Enhancement Rs.2,68,222/-
 NC: 2026:KHC-K:990 HC-KAR  Thus, the clamant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.2,68,222/- rounded of to Rs.2,68,300/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum.

6. In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER I.
The appeal is allowed in part.
II. The appellant/claimant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.2,68,300/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
III. Respondent No.2 - Insurance Company is directed to deposit the aforesaid compensation amount within six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.

IV. Taking into consideration the order dated 04.02.2025, the claimant is not entitled for NC:
2026:KHC-K:990 HC-KAR interest, for the delayed period of 348 days in filing the appeal.
V. Learned counsel Sri S.S.Aspalli is permitted to file memo of appearance within four weeks from today.

Sd/-
(E.S.INDIRESH) JUDGE SRT List No.: 1 Sl No.: 9 CT:PK Kumar vs Pintu And Anr on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132110075/
